The CSP10 discovery audit confirms that adapter removal currently empties model discovery. Two existing race tests pass and preserve that behavior. The approved contract requires permitted membership to remain visible.

CSP10 uses starport-catalog-routing on codex/starport-catalog-routing at c99fd0d. Use GOWORK=/tmp/csp10-host-integration.work. The compatibility authority proof records nine repaired disclosure paths. The regression reports eleven failing events before repair and eleven passing events after repair.

The final proxy race suite passes 189 events. Server and controller checks pass 467 events with one optional skip. Lint and new-test prose checks pass. No verification process remains active. The preceding HTTP discovery proof retains endpoint qualification.

Endpoint cache serialization remains with CSP12.1. Preserve reviewed branches and await the PR #168 history decision. CSP10 remains incomplete without task completion credit.

The prior CSP10 preparation at Starport 460358a in starport-catalog-routing. The worktree is clean. The caller disclosure proof records 696 passing race events and one optional benchmark skip. Lint, vet, and new-source prose checks pass. All commands are terminal.

The reader disclosure implementation at Starport dde50a7 remains historical evidence. The reader disclosure proof records 512 passing race events and one optional benchmark skip. Reader summaries and change feeds apply current permitted membership and reject generation mismatches. Lint, vet, and new prose checks pass.

Starmap registry commit 1ef193e0d registers A18 disclosure checks. Its 81 verifier tests pass. At Starport dde50a7, A18 disclosure passes all 24 registered checks. Four A18 subcases remain unverified. The overall gate remains FAIL. All processes are terminal.

Prior CSP10 preparation used Starport fddeafc. The alias and endpoint proof records active aliases, explicit removal, route-name collision rejection, and exact path decoding. The final endpoint suite passes 404 race events with one optional benchmark skip. Lint, vet, and new prose pass. Both implementation worktrees are clean, and all commands are terminal.

The registry now requires 25 disclosure checks. Its 81 verifier tests pass. Repeat complete task acceptance for the final source pair. Next, audit denied membership and unavailable or unsupported operation errors. Then qualify canonical removal, SDK transitions, retries, and queued admission. Publication, native qualification, review, and merge remain required.

The request transition proof records Starport 7cb87bb. Ten repeated race runs preserve the admitted generation and reject new requests for a removed alias. Canonical requests use the replacement generation. All 97 router test events pass without skips.

Vet, lint, and changed-source prose checks pass. No commands remain active. The subsequent HTTP proof below qualifies alias transitions through the serialized discovery cache.

The HTTP alias proof records Starport 9cc73fa. Both protocol families pass authenticated alias activation and removal with the real serialized cache. Account restrictions hide previously cached models. The server and controller suites pass 495 race events with one optional skip. Vet, lint, and new-test prose checks pass. All commands are terminal.

The explicit registry fixture avoids loading an unrelated embedded catalog. Its test event took 0.04 seconds, compared with 10.9 seconds before this change. This observation does not measure gateway request latency. Canonical removal, SDK transitions, and remaining admission cases still require qualification.

The missing-model proof records Starport c99fd0d. Six HTTP cases failed before repair and pass afterward. Chat, streaming, and embeddings now return 404 for absent catalog names. Explicit fallback, automatic fallback, and account overrides remain valid. Final checks pass 796 race events with one optional skip. Vet, lint, and new-test prose checks pass.
